newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.070pts to 103.461.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.070pts to 103.461.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.070 points in Thursday's trading to 103.461 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.769 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.067 points to 100.981, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.382 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 2.652 points to 1,021.731.
